title: Trading Game
lead: Real price data. Make your call, then see what actually happened.
pool: <num>{n}</num> questions at this level, shuffled every round
revealNote: The candles after the ENTRY line ({price}) are the {n} candles that were hidden.
hiddenNote: The next {n} candles are hidden. Where do you think price goes from <mono>{price}</mono>?
tapHint: Tap an underlined word to see what it means.

summary.good: Nice, your chart reading is getting sharper.
summary.keepGoing: Every miss is something to learn from.

situation.lead: {pair} {timeframe}, {period}. The trend leans {trend} and price now sits at {pos}% of the last 30 candles' range.
situation.both: Resistance is {r, plural, one {# pip} other {# pips}} above, support {s, plural, one {# pip} other {# pips}} below.
situation.resistanceOnly: Resistance is {r, plural, one {# pip} other {# pips}} above the current price.
situation.supportOnly: Support is {s, plural, one {# pip} other {# pips}} below the current price.
situation.none: There's no strong level near the current price.

reasons.trend: Over the last 30 candles the trend leans {trend} (a slope of {slope} pips per candle).
reasons.resistance: The nearest resistance is at {price}, about {pips, plural, one {# pip} other {# pips}} above the current price (touched {touches}x).
reasons.noResistance: There's no clear resistance above the current price in the last 30 candles.
reasons.support: The nearest support is at {price}, about {pips, plural, one {# pip} other {# pips}} below the current price (touched {touches}x).
reasons.noSupport: There's no clear support below the current price in the last 30 candles.
reasons.range: Price sits at {pos}% of the last 30 candles' range ({lo} – {hi}).
reasons.result: The result: over the next 15 candles price moved {change} from the entry price.

suggestion.buy: Price rose {change} after this point, so BUY is the answer. Look for confirmation in the direction of the trend first, and put your stop loss below the nearest support.
suggestion.buySl: Price rose {change} after this point, so BUY is the answer. Look for confirmation in the direction of the trend first, and put your stop loss below the nearest support (about {pips, plural, one {# pip} other {# pips}}).
suggestion.sell: Price fell {change} after this point, so SELL is the answer. Wait for a rejection at resistance, and put your stop loss above the nearest resistance.
suggestion.sellSl: Price fell {change} after this point, so SELL is the answer. Wait for a rejection at resistance, and put your stop loss above the nearest resistance (about {pips, plural, one {# pip} other {# pips}}).
suggestion.wait: Price only moved {change}, inside the ±0.1% threshold, so WAIT is the answer. When the market gives no edge in either direction, staying out is a decision too.

feedback.buyRight: Correct. Price rose {moved}% over the next 15 candles.
feedback.buyOpposite: Not quite. Price actually fell {moved}% after this point.
feedback.buyFlat: Not quite. Price barely moved ({change}), so a buy wouldn't have made anything.
feedback.sellRight: Correct. Price fell {moved}% over the next 15 candles.
feedback.sellOpposite: Not quite. Price actually rose {moved}% after this point.
feedback.sellFlat: Not quite. Price barely moved ({change}), so a sell wouldn't have made anything.
feedback.waitRight: Correct. Price only moved {change}, still inside the ±0.1% threshold.
feedback.waitWrong: Not quite. Price moved {change}, big enough to trade rather than sit out.
